candidate_workaround: Permit staged-review generation only at the exact evidence head or the exact known closeout correction parent, and reject every other head.
failure_signature: The final-review lifecycle guard refused the known pushed closeout parent while preparing an additive terminal correction.
recurrence_guard: Bind correction-capable lifecycle tools to an explicit finite set of attributable parent heads rather than relaxing exact-head checks generally.
rollback: Retain the refused correction review at zero credit and stop if the current head is neither the evidence head nor the known closeout parent.
scope_boundary: One owner-local staged-review correction path only; no arbitrary-head validation.
title: Bind correction review to exact attributable parent heads
trigger_preconditions: An additive terminal correction follows a clean pushed closeout commit.
